title: Count Qualified Leads by Sales Representative
description_markdown: Sales leadership request: Count qualified leads (`status = 'qualified'`) per sales rep in `leads`. Return `sr.name AS rep_name`, `sr.territory`, and `COUNT(l.lead_id) AS qualified_leads`. Order by `qualified_leads` DESC, `sr.rep_id` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Qualified leads per rep
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT sr.name AS rep_name, sr.territory, COUNT(l.lead_id) AS qualified_leads FROM sales_reps sr JOIN leads l ON sr.rep_id = l.rep_id WHERE l.status = 'qualified' GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.territory ORDER BY qualified_leads DESC, sr.rep_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Quantifies top-of-funnel discovery qualification by territory rep.
hints: Filter with `WHERE l.status = 'qualified'`.

title: Calculate Quota Attainment Percentage for Closed Deals
description_markdown: Sales ops request: For closed won opportunities (`stage = 'closed_won'`), calculate each rep's total closed deal volume (`SUM(o.deal_size)` as `closed_revenue`), and quota attainment percentage: `ROUND((SUM(o.deal_size) / sr.quota) * 100.0, 2)` as `attainment_pct`. Return `sr.name`, `sr.quota`, `closed_revenue`, and `attainment_pct`. Order by `attainment_pct` DESC.
starter_query:

SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT sr.name, sr.quota, SUM(o.deal_size) AS closed_revenue, ROUND((SUM(o.deal_size) / sr.quota) * 100.0, 2) AS attainment_pct FROM sales_reps sr JOIN leads l ON sr.rep_id = l.rep_id JOIN opportunities o ON l.lead_id = o.lead_id WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won' GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC, sr.rep_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Measures attainment performance versus assigned quota targets.
hints: Join sales_reps -> leads -> opportunities with stage = 'closed_won'.
Focus on the required WHERE, JOIN, or GROUP BY clause conditions.

Query: SELECT sr.name, sr.quota, SUM(o.deal_size) AS closed_revenue, ROUND((SUM(o.deal_size) / sr.quota) * 100.0, 2) AS attainment_pct FROM sales_reps sr JOIN leads l ON sr.rep_id = l.rep_id JOIN opportunities o ON l.lead_id = o.lead_id WHERE o.stage = 'closed_won' GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota ORDER BY attainment_pct DESC, sr.rep_id ASC;

Query: SELECT contract_id, annual_contract_value, duration_months, CASE WHEN duration_months >= 36 THEN 'Long-Term (3yr+)' WHEN duration_months >= 24 THEN 'Medium-Term (2yr)' ELSE 'Annual (1yr)' END AS commitment_type FROM contracts ORDER BY duration_months DESC, contract_id ASC;

title: Track Previous Closed Deal Size with Window LAG

Query: SELECT opportunity_id, deal_size, stage, close_date, LAG(deal_size) OVER (ORDER BY close_date ASC, opportunity_id ASC) AS prev_deal_size FROM opportunities ORDER BY close_date ASC, opportunity_id ASC;

title: Calculate Quota Deficit and Shortfall Gap per Sales Rep
description_markdown: Quota gap analysis: For each sales representative, calculate total closed won revenue (`COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_size), 0.00)` as `actual_revenue`), and the remaining quota deficit (`CASE WHEN sr.quota > actual_revenue THEN (sr.quota - actual_revenue) ELSE 0.00 END` as `quota_gap`). Return `sr.name`, `sr.quota`, `actual_revenue`, and `quota_gap`. Order by `quota_gap` DESC, `sr.rep_id` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Write your solution query here
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT sr.name, sr.quota, COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_size), 0.00) AS actual_revenue, CASE WHEN sr.quota > COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_size), 0.00) THEN (sr.quota - COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_size), 0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END AS quota_gap FROM sales_reps sr LEFT JOIN leads l ON sr.rep_id = l.rep_id LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON l.lead_id = o.lead_id AND o.stage = 'closed_won' GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota ORDER BY quota_gap DESC, sr.rep_id ASC;
solution_explanation: Measures shortfall between target quota and realized won revenue.
hints: Use `LEFT JOIN` on leads and opportunities (`AND o.stage = 'closed_won'`).
Group by `sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota`.

Query: SELECT sr.name, sr.quota, COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_size), 0.00) AS actual_revenue, CASE WHEN sr.quota > COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_size), 0.00) THEN (sr.quota - COALESCE(SUM(o.deal_size), 0.00)) ELSE 0.00 END AS quota_gap FROM sales_reps sr LEFT JOIN leads l ON sr.rep_id = l.rep_id LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON l.lead_id = o.lead_id AND o.stage = 'closed_won' GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota ORDER BY quota_gap DESC, sr.rep_id ASC;

hints: Use scalar subquery `(SELECT SUM(deal_size) FROM opportunities WHERE stage = 'closed_won')` as denominator.

title: Aggregate Pipeline Health and Value Distribution by Stage

solution_query: SELECT stage, COUNT(opportunity_id) AS deal_count, SUM(deal_size) AS stage_volume, ROUND((SUM(deal_size) * 100.0) / (SELECT SUM(deal_size) FROM opportunities), 2) AS stage_pct FROM opportunities GROUP BY stage ORDER BY stage_volume DESC, stage ASC;

title: Compute Contract Monthly Run-Rate and Lifetime Value
description_markdown: Financial run-rate: For executed contracts, compute monthly revenue run-rate: `ROUND(c.annual_contract_value / 12.0, 2)` as `monthly_run_rate`, and total lifetime value: `ROUND(c.annual_contract_value * (c.duration_months / 12.0), 2)` as `contract_lifetime_value`. Join `contracts`, `opportunities`, and `leads`. Return `l.company_name`, `c.annual_contract_value`, `c.duration_months`, `monthly_run_rate`, and `contract_lifetime_value`. Order by `contract_lifetime_value` DESC, `l.company_name` ASC.
starter_query:
-- Write your solution query here
SELECT ...
solution_query: SELECT l.company_name, c.annual_contract_value, c.duration_months, ROUND(c.annual_contract_value / 12.0, 2) AS monthly_run_rate, ROUND(c.annual_contract_value * (c.duration_months / 12.0), 2) AS contract_lifetime_value FROM contracts c JOIN opportunities o ON c.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id JOIN leads l ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id ORDER BY contract_lifetime_value DESC, l.company_name ASC;
solution_explanation: Converts contracted annual revenues into recurring monthly run rates and total LTV.
hints: Join `contracts c` to `opportunities o` to `leads l`.
Compute `ROUND(c.annual_contract_value / 12.0, 2)` as `monthly_run_rate`.

Query: SELECT l.company_name, c.annual_contract_value, c.duration_months, ROUND(c.annual_contract_value / 12.0, 2) AS monthly_run_rate, ROUND(c.annual_contract_value * (c.duration_months / 12.0), 2) AS contract_lifetime_value FROM contracts c JOIN opportunities o ON c.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id JOIN leads l ON o.lead_id = l.lead_id ORDER BY contract_lifetime_value DESC, l.company_name ASC;

title: Calculate Lead Qualification Conversion Rate by Representative

solution_query: SELECT sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS lead_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.stage = 'closed_won' THEN o.opportunity_id END) AS won_deals, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.stage = 'closed_won' THEN o.deal_size ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS won_volume FROM sales_reps sr LEFT JOIN leads l ON sr.rep_id = l.rep_id LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON l.lead_id = o.lead_id GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota ORDER BY won_volume DESC, sr.rep_id ASC;

Query: SELECT sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota, COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS lead_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.stage = 'closed_won' THEN o.opportunity_id END) AS won_deals, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.stage = 'closed_won' THEN o.deal_size ELSE 0.00 END), 0.00) AS won_volume FROM sales_reps sr LEFT JOIN leads l ON sr.rep_id = l.rep_id LEFT JOIN opportunities o ON l.lead_id = o.lead_id GROUP BY sr.rep_id, sr.name, sr.quota ORDER BY won_volume DESC, sr.rep_id ASC;
